keywords: The Petitioners are Members of the Director Board of the 15th Respondent; Panel of Inquiry appointed by the 1st Respondent to inquire into the affairs of the 15th Respondent; After initial stage, without recording a statement or calling for observations from the Petitioners, Panel of Inquiry recommended to suspend the Board of Management and appoint an Interim Management Committee; Petitioners challenge the same. Held – There was improper procedure followed and violation of rules of natural justice. Writs issued.
